build.buildCommand: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader && php artisan config:clear && npm ci && npm run build:ssr && php artisan config:cache && php artisan route:cache && php artisan view:cache

deploy.startCommand: php artisan migrate --force && php artisan storage:link && (php artisan inertia:start-ssr > /tmp/ssr.log 2>&1 & ) && php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=$PORT
